en: Changed Code Review's pull request reviews and `/ultrareview` to run when `disableWorkflows` is on, unless the machine running the review has it set by its own administrator (MDM or the managed-settings file)
zh: 变更 Code Review 的拉取请求审查和 `/ultrareview`，使其在 `disableWorkflows` 开启时仍可运行，除非运行审查的机器由其自身管理员（MDM 或 managed-settings 文件）设置了该项
